description:
## Goal

Separate immutable executable content identity from diagnostic provenance after the atomic source-owner boundary exists. A location-only source replacement updates current diagnostics while preserving equal backend/native content allocation and generation.

## Authority

Executable products own semantic/runtime content. Exact source-version owners retain diagnostic locations. Consumers request the projection they need; do not omit spans from equality while returning an old span-bearing object, and do not add a second artifact/source mirror.

## TDD

Use explicit replace_source for formatting-only change, content change, current error span, retained old diagnostic/artifact and macro-generated provenance. Prove zero native codegen and no unchanged macro-result consumer wake for location-only change, exact relevant movement for content change, and bounded retained provenance.

## Deletion and acceptance

Delete span-coupled executable equality, duplicate provenance mirrors, replacement adapters and stale docs. Same-version artifacts remain exact; current diagnostics name the current immutable source version. fz-tfn.57 is prerequisite; fz-tfn.20 later frees versions with no owner.
title: Separate diagnostic provenance from retained executable content identity
